nodes.description: Private owner address of BabyShiba; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the privileged access-control gate in ensure, delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and _mints and read for balance checks.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances; read/written in transferFrom and approve.
Private mapping(address => bool) whitelist of addresses allowed to transfer; set true only by _mints and checked in ensure.
Private mapping(address => uint256) counting how many sell operations an address performed; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private uint256 minimum sale amount threshold, set by init and enforced in condition.
Private uint256 maximum sale amount threshold, set by init and enforced in condition.
Private uint256 maximum number of sales allowed per address, set by init and enforced in condition.
Address of an allowed trading venue; set by setTradeAddress and bypassed against in ensure.
Public total token supply, assigned in the constructor from the _supply argument.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for scaling amounts in _mints and init.
Public token name string assigned in the constructor.
Public token symbol string assigned in the constructor.
Constant hard-coded Uniswap V2 Router address (0x7a25...) used as a privileged address in ensure and as a pre-approved spender in the constructor.
BabyShiba constructor: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, mints all supply to owner and grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router; emits Transfer.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).

Public payable core transfer routine: deducts allowance, enforces the ensure gate, mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to], increments _onSaleNum[_from] and emits Transfer; uses unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally and emits Approval; no zero-address or return-value handling.
Internal view gate checking owner, hard-coded router (UNI), computed pair address, tradeAddress and canSale whitelist; otherwise requires condition(_from,_value).
Internal view function implementing sale-count/min/max restrictions from _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable function performing a delegatecall to user-supplied address a with user-supplied bytes b; guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner).
Public mint-like function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] using addedValue*10**decimals and whitelists the spender in canSale; restricted to owner or a hard-coded address.
Public owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum (scaled by decimals); missing explicit return value.
Public payable owner-only batch distribution looping over _tos, mutating balanceOf and emitting two Transfer events per recipient; uses unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
Public owner-only setter that assigns tradeAddress, which bypasses the sale conditions in ensure.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address computation via keccak256 of factory, sorted tokens and the init code hash.
Caller-controlled address used for privilege checks (owner gates), as transfer origin and as the approve/allowance owner.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value and _onSaleNum[_from]++ (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath).
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata inside delegate(); if the owner key is compromised this allows full storage takeover of BabyShiba.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can overflow/underflow.
Unchecked arithmetic in _mints: addedValue * (10**uint256(decimals)) can silently overflow and overwrite balances.
Parameter _to of transfer (recipient forwarded to transferFrom).
Parameter _value of transfer (amount forwarded to transferFrom).
Parameter _from of transferFrom (debited account, checked against msg.sender/allowance).
Parameter _to of transferFrom (credited account).
Parameter _value of transferFrom (amount transferred and fed into ensure/condition).
Parameter _tos address array iterated over in batchSend.
Parameter _value of batchSend, multiplied by array length and credited to each recipient.
Parameter a of delegate(): target address for the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(): raw calldata for the delegatecall.
Parameter spender of _mints whose balance is overwritten and who is whitelisted.
Parameter addedValue of _mints, scaled by 10**decimals to overwrite balanceOf[spender].
Parameter saleNum of init, assigned to _saleNum.
Parameter token of init, optionally scaled and assigned to _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init, optionally scaled and assigned to _maxSale.
Parameter _spender of approve, used as the allowance key.
Parameter _value of approve, stored as the allowance amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress, assigned to tradeAddress.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; computed with unchecked multiplication and compared against the sender balance.
Loop index i in batchSend controlling iteration over _tos.
Local variable _to holding _tos[i] inside the batchSend loop.
Local variable _UNI in ensure holding the computed pair address from pairFor for comparison against _from.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable, making the deployer the privileged account.
msg.sender is used as the spender/origin for the allowance check and as implicit _from in transfer().
msg.sender indexes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] in approve, letting the caller set any allowance for itself.
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard before the arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender must equal owner or a hard-coded address to mint/whitelist in _mints.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the init() configuration of min/max sale thresholds.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the batchSend distribution loop.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates setTradeAddress, which can disable the sale restrictions.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) which decides whether the transfer is permitted (whitelist/condition gate).
transferFrom performs unchecked subtractions/additions on allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) when no whitelist exemption matches.
ensure calls pairFor to derive _UNI, the Uniswap pair address, for the exemption check.
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner state variable to bypass restrictions.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress to bypass restrictions.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping for the sender.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sale amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sale amount.
condition reads _saleNum and compares it with _onSaleNum[_from].
delegate() executes an attacker-supplied address and calldata via delegatecall, a high-risk operation guarded only by the owner check.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the address in ensure.
_mints computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) with unchecked arithmetic in Solidity 0.5.
init writes the scaled token parameter into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maxToken parameter into _maxSale.
init writes saleNum into _saleNum.
batchSend decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and increments balanceOf[_to] for each recipient.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it without overflow checks.
setTradeAddress assigns the caller-supplied addr to tradeAddress, which is an exemption address in ensure.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor mints the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
transfer forwards its _to parameter into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value parameter into transferFrom.
_from is compared with msg.sender and used to index allowance and balanceOf.
_to is the credited address in transferFrom.
_value determines the allowance deduction and balance deltas in transferFrom.
_value is passed to ensure and ultimately condition for min/max sale validation.
_tos array is iterated to determine recipients in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited to every recipient in batchSend.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address in delegate().
Parameter b is the raw calldata executed via delegatecall in delegate().
spender indexes balanceOf and canSale in _mints.
addedValue is scaled and written into balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
saleNum parameter is written to _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled and written to _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled and written to _maxSale in init.
_spender is the allowance key in approve.
_value is stored as the allowance amount in approve.
addr is assigned to the tradeAddress state variable in setTradeAddress.
Local total holds the unchecked product of _value and array length used for the balance check.
Local index i drives the batchSend for-loop over _tos.
Local _to holds _tos[i] and receives the credited balance/events.
Local _UNI holds the pairFor result compared against _from inside ensure.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used to forward the recipient into transferFrom; it has no independent semantic role.
_value is only forwarded to transferFrom; it carries no independent semantic role.
_from is a plain input to the balance/allowance mutations inside transferFrom.
_to is a plain input to the credit operation inside transferFrom.
_value directly parameterizes the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
_tos is only iterated inside the batchSend loop.
_value feeds the unchecked multiplication/subtraction in batchSend.
a is the target address of the delegatecall and belongs to that unsafe operation.
b is the raw calldata of the delegatecall and belongs to that unsafe operation.
spender only keys the balanceOf/canSale writes performed by _mints.
addedValue is the operand of the unchecked multiplication in _mints.
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum by init.
token is only scaled and stored into _minSale by init.
maxToken is only scaled and stored into _maxSale by init.
_spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
_value is only stored as the allowance amount inside approve.
addr is only assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress.
total exists solely to hold the unchecked product consumed by the batchSend arithmetic.
i is a transient loop counter with no state significance.
_to is a transient per-iteration copy of _tos[i].
_UNI is a transient computed pair address used only inside the ensure exemption check.
